description: Checks a clip render for a workout or program and returns the clips once ready. Use when the progress card from generate_clips refreshes. Not for starting a render (use generate_clips). Returns status, progress and the clip formats; playable links go to the player only.

id.description: ID of the workout or program. Get it from list_team_workouts or list_team_programs.

locale.description: Language of the clips, e.g. "en-US". Workouts only; program clips use the team default. Omit for the team default.

type.description: What to act on: workout = a single workout; program = a multi-week program.

name: get_clips
title: Get clips status
